original.heading: Our Story
paragraphs:
Our journey began in 2007, inspired by the Artisans in the centuries old ceramic enclave of Civita Castellana, Italy.

Our idea was simple - to make the finest Italian Bathware accessible to homes across Australia.

We began distributing our products through a handful of retail and commercial outlets. As our business grew, our products quickly gained the attention of the design community, and our distribution grew.

Today we are proud to deal with hundreds of distributors and designers all over Australia.

At Studio Bagno, we’re not distant curators, we’re your Bathware enthusiasts.

Our goal remains simple – to enhance your bathing experience with pieces that tell a story of timeless design and craftsmanship.

We hope our Bathware adds a little bit of joy to your daily bathing ritual.

journal.summary: Explore the Pastoria Master Suite renovation of Koos de Keijzer and Clemence Harvey’s off-grid home, featuring Italian travertine, Studio Bagno’s Milady pan and serene country views.
journal.title: Pastoria Master Suite Renovation. A Serene Country Scene.
journal.sourceCredit: Jade Cantwell photography (article credit; thumbnail-specific rights not established)

journal.summary: Water efficiency in concealed cistern systems is typically measured in litres per flush. Oli approaches it differently — through sequencing. Rather than reducing how much water is used, the system focuses on how precisely the flush cycle is controlled, delivering meaningful efficiency without compromising performance.
journal.title: Precision Without Waste — The Oli Difference

journal.summary: Encore by Mingara on the NSW Central Coast is a five-storey, 86-room hotel designed by Marchese Partners. This Project Spotlight explores the architectural intent, bathroom specification strategy, and the role of cohesive ceramic solutions in delivering long-term hospitality performance.
journal.title: Encore By Mingara — Marchese Partners

journal.summary: Warm minimalism favours calm, considered interiors shaped by proportion, material restraint, and softness. Within this context, organic form allows bathroom elements to integrate quietly through gentle curves and continuous surfaces, supporting clarity, cohesion, and long-term design intent.
journal.title: Organic Form, Warm Minimalism

journal.summary: The Idilla Series and Fall V2 Undercounter basins represent two distinct but complementary approaches to ceramic specification. Each is shaped by clear design intent and conceived to support real-world planning across residential and light commercial projects, where longevity, consistency, and visual discipline matter.
journal.title: Idilla & Fall V2 — Italian Ceramics For Contemporary Specification

journal.summary: Our Undercounter Basin range expands with a renewed commitment to subtle design and intelligent performance. This deeper, more versatile collection offers refined solutions for modern bathrooms — bringing together architectural clarity, technical precision, and aesthetic restraint.
journal.title: Design Beneath The Surface – Discover Our Undercounter Range

journal.summary: Studio Bagno redefines the role of gloss within the contemporary bathroom. Our latest collection of Italian-made gloss finishes introduces colour and vibrancy — transforming surfaces into sculptural elements that engage with light and space.
journal.title: The Return Of Gloss, Direct From Italy

journal.summary: Where geometry meets craftsmanship, Shard X redefines the architectural basin. Refined, deliberate, and beautifully proportioned, it embodies expressive minimalism with enduring presence.
journal.title: Design Excellence For Small Bathrooms – Shard X

journal.summary: Where form meets feeling — the Happy Hour series by Hatria Ceramica brings Italian artistry into the rhythm of everyday life. Compact in size yet bold in character, each basin blends sculptural elegance with pure functionality.
journal.title: The New Happy Hour Series

journal.summary: Our latest additions to our collection of freestanding baths explores good design through proportion and functionality, offering sculptural forms that bring a sense of luxury to small bathroom spaces.
journal.title: Compact Luxury: 🛁 Sculptural Baths For Smaller Bathrooms

journal.summary: With its soft curvature, generous proportions, and finely resolved detailing, the collection blurs the line between function and sculpture — a series that feels timeless, tactile, and distinctly modern.
journal.title: The Idilla Series

journal.summary: Every September, Cersaie transforms Bologna into the world’s centre for ceramic and bathroom innovation. Our team was on the ground again this year to explore what’s next — gathering insights from Europe’s leading manufacturers to share with the Australian design community.
journal.title: Cersaie 2025 Wrap-up

journal.summary: Available in three sizes — 50cm, 60cm and 80cm — with a refined projection of just 365mm, Bahia is perfectly suited to powder rooms and ensuites. Crafted in Italy by Hatria Ceramica, it embodies precision and elegance in equal measure.
journal.title: New Bahia Basins - Bold Lines, Subtle Details

journal.summary: This year, Studio Bagno is leading the charge with an extensive collection of new releases direct from Italy, available in a rich palette of Gloss Colour. Design with absolute freedom.
journal.title: New Gloss Colour Releases, Direct From Italy

journal.summary: Our most specified baths — now with more choice than ever. From compact ensuites to statement master bathrooms, these Studio Bagno favourites continue to define bathroom design across the country.⁠
journal.title: The Baths Designers Keep Coming Back To

journal.summary: In this rare and candid walkthrough, William shares his design approach to the reimagined terrace houses — creating an urban typology that’s both bold and elegantly restrained.
journal.title: Project Spotlight - Portman St. Terraces By Smart Design Studio

journal.summary: Defined by soft curves, generous walls and fine detailing, each piece in the collection has been sculpted to stand as both a functional object and a quiet work of art.
journal.title: Meet Idilla - The Bold New Basin Series Direct From Italy

journal.summary: Internationally awarded for design excellence, Futura the latest evolution in contemporary bathroomware direct from Italy
journal.title: Best In Class Vortex Flush Is Here

journal.summary: Design and personality for every hour — the new Happy Hour series brings expressive form and everyday functionality to life. Available in versatile bench and under counter options, as well as a refined pallete of contemporary colours.
journal.title: New Happy Hour Series - A New Mood For The Bathroom

journal.summary: With a bold new visual identity and a cleaner navigation, the new site is a more intuitive and immersive way to explore the full Studio Bagno collection.
journal.title: New Website Launch!

journal.summary: Slim has been updated with a fresh new line-up: Light Brass, Brass, Gun Metal and Copper—designed to match or complement a wide range of materials, palettes and bathroom aesthetics.
journal.title: Meet The New Slim Flush Button Finishes

journal.summary: Our new Undercounter Basin range expands with a deeper and more versatile offering—crafted to suit the diverse demands of contemporary bathrooms.
journal.title: New Undercounter Basins! A Deeper Offering..

journal.summary: Edition 9 of our Black Book Catalogue celebrates 18 years with a bold new direction and over 16 new product lines including sculptural italian-made centrepieces, new colour palettes, small bathroom heroes and the very latest in vortex flush performance.
journal.title: New Catalogue Out Now - Our Boldest Release Yet!

journal.summary: Architectural Precision direct from Italy, available in 4 variations and a rich palette of matte and gloss colours, the new Shard X Bench basins are a bold wash area centrepiece, even in small bathrooms.
journal.title: New Shard X Basins - Beautiful Geometry

journal.summary: Boasting a refined, sculptural form the new Hyde series of rimless toilets sets a new benchmark in balancing high-end design and functionality.
journal.title: Hyde Has Arrived: The New Contender In Rimless Design

journal.summary: With three versatile configurations, a tactile matte white finish, and advanced rimless technology, the collection delivers elevated design with everyday practicality.
journal.title: Meet Manhattan: Design + Engineered Precision

journal.summary: We've made it simple to find baths with overflow when specifying for your bathroom projects. Explore a growing range with integrated Overflow, from sculptural forms to sleek contemporary silhouettes, our collection brings together aestheic design and peace of mind functionality.
journal.title: Baths With Overflow: Simplifying Selection

journal.summary: Studio Bagno’s Wall Faced Pans are designed to recede elegantly into their surrounds, concealing the cistern behind the wall, offering a more streamlined wall / floor silhouette.
journal.title: Built For Performance. Styled To Impress - Wall Faced Pans

journal.summary: Explore a vast range of basin with overflow, available in an extensive array of styles and configurations for any bathroom space and vision.
journal.title: Basins With Overflow, Made Simple

journal.summary: Explore Olympia Ceramica’s rimless soft-square masterpiece, its space-saving versatility, and how it seamlessly integrates with Studio Bagno’s Soft Square Collection. Perfect for architects and homeowners alike, this is bathroom sophistication, redefined.
journal.title: Soft Square, Sophisticated: Meet Synthesis Eco

journal.summary: Experience the art of bathing with the Nur Freestanding Bath—crafted from luxurious MarmoTech for superior warmth and comfort. Designed to pair seamlessly with the Nur Basins and Milady Toilet, it’s the perfect centrepiece for a refined bathroom.
journal.title: The Nur Bath - Bathing, Perfected

journal.summary: Discover the artistry of Italian-made colour ceramic with Studio Bagno. Crafted by skilled artisans in Civita Castellana, our collection features a rich palette of matte and glossy finishes, offering both contemporary and timeless hues.
